input.quote: For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for as long as the Software is covered by Maintenance Services and is used by Sparkling in accordance with this Agreement, Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects.
input.rationale: Section 12 gives a one-year (and continuing) warranty that the Software conforms to the Specifications, which satisfies the fallback software conformance element. However, nothing warrants the quality of Garman's Maintenance Services, and Section 12 provides no warranty remedy: repair exists only as a maintenance obligation (Section 10(c)), and the only refund mechanic is the acceptance-period rejection right in Sections 7-8 ("in lieu of any other remedy"), which expires once the Software is accepted. The Agreement therefore fails the fallback on the services warranty and the refund/repair remedy. We target the fallback with one inserted sentence pair adding a 30-day Maintenance Services warranty and a repair, replacement or refund remedy; there is no general warranty disclaimer that would swallow the express warranty.

proposal.summary: Add a 30-day Maintenance Services warranty and a repair/replace/refund remedy to Section 12.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Software conformance warranty runs for a year, but the Agreement warrants nothing about the Maintenance Services and gives no warranty remedy, so we added a 30-day services warranty and a repair, replacement or refund remedy at our fallback position.

ops.text: Garman further warrants that the Maintenance Services shall be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner for a period of thirty (30) calendar days following their performance. Sparkling's remedy for breach of the warranties in this Section 12 is, at Garman's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Software or Maintenance Services, or a refund of the fees paid for them.
